disposition_reason: The original CBraMod full twelve-dataset program has ordered decoding endpoints, but original cohort/split identities and a complete same-support baseline are unrecovered. The author explicitly disclaims exact split comparability for historical TUAB/TUEV comparisons and replaced their splitting code after publication. The current implementation's person-held-out 30%-label condition changes the original task and is only an extension. Recovering PhysioNet Table 3 alone cannot qualify this full-panel task.

target.description: Original ten BCI task families across FACED, SEED-V, PhysioNet-MI, SHU-MI, ISRUC, CHB-MIT, BCIC2020-3, Mumtaz2016, SEED-VIG, MentalArithmetic, TUEV and TUAB: emotion, motor imagery, sleep stage, seizure, imagined speech, depression, vigilance regression, mental workload, event type and abnormal EEG prediction. Preserve the full program and central ablations.

dataset.description: All twelve original datasets are required; TUEG pretraining is a distinct input. Author confirms TUAB3.0.1 and TUEV2.0.0; PhysioNet source names EEGMMI1.0.0. Exact archived releases, artifact identities, source-to-row joins and pretraining-overlap manifests are not recovered for the full panel.

cohort.description: Paper counts include FACED123, SEED-V16, PhysioNet109, SHU25, ISRUC100, CHB-MIT23, BCIC2020-3 15, Mumtaz64, SEED-VIG23 and MentalArithmetic36 participants. Exact participant-to-file mapping and exclusions remain incomplete; overlapping clinical case IDs cannot be presumed independent people.

split.description: Retain each original paper split, including within-person trial splits for SEED-V/BCIC2020-3 and original participant splits elsewhere. PhysioNet specifies1-70/71-89/90-109, but code slices an unfiltered sorted staging directory. TUAB/TUEV historical comparison split identities are explicitly unrecovered; deterministic June2025 splits or universal person-held-out splits are different conditions.

inputs.description: Source-defined EEG channels, epoch durations and context, original supervision budget and declared pretrained TUEG/model access. ISRUC uses20 successive30-second epochs; preserving sequence context is part of the input. A30%-label condition cannot replace original full-label results.

preprocessing.description: Bind each original dataset recipe to its original cohort and code revision: source uses200Hz one-second patches with task-specific filtering, channels and windowing. PhysioNet preprocessing is directly inspected, but paper/source disagreements and full twelve-dataset native parity remain unresolved; silently correcting staging or sequence joins would change the task.

metric.description: Original panel: balanced accuracy, Cohen kappa and weighted F1 for multiclass; balanced accuracy, PR area and ROC area for binary; Pearson correlation, R2 and RMSE for vigilance regression. Higher is better except RMSE. Balanced accuracy is mean class recall; kappa=(observed agreement-chance agreement)/(1-chance agreement); weighted F1 uses class support. No source-defined scalar over heterogeneous datasets exists. Native binary decisions use sigmoid(logit)>0.5; PR area is trapezoidal auc(recall,precision), not average precision. R2=1-SSE/SST and RMSE=sqrt(mean squared error); Pearson uses np.corrcoef. Exact undefined-class and ISRUC sequence handling require runtime qualification.

aggregation.description: Paper reports mean and standard deviation across five random seeds per dataset, without a single cross-dataset score. Exact five seed identities and SD denominator remain unbound. Subject/trial aggregation and original support must be recovered per endpoint before combining evidence.

comparison.primary_metric: Complete paper dataset-specific metric panel; no recovered paper-wide scalar or scientifically admitted primary decision rule

published_baseline.description: No single scalar summarizes the full paper task. Recovered original Table3 PhysioNet CBraMod components are balanced accuracy0.6417±0.0091, kappa0.5222±0.0169 and weighted F1 0.6427±0.0100; SHU components are0.6370,0.7139,0.6988. These are published component scores, not a completed full-panel reference or compatible TUAB/TUEV baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The pinned source package contains author-loader routes but no authenticated full twelve-dataset original-split rerun and no complete comparator prediction panel. Re-running revised deterministic TUAB/TUEV splits produces a new matched-split baseline, not the historical same-task baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Define meaningful gains per task metric and a non-cherry-picked full-panel decision before evaluation. No common percentage, pooled score or arbitrary tolerance is scientifically justified across emotion, clinical classification and vigilance regression.

uncertainty.method: Original support must be reconstructed before specifying paired hierarchical uncertainty: account for biological participant, session/trial dependence and training-seed variation per dataset, with a predeclared multiplicity rule for the full panel. No threshold or confidence level has been adopted.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological participants for participant-generalization tasks; original within-person held-out trials conditional on subject for SEED-V/BCIC2020-3; independent training runs for optimization variability, never individual overlapping EEG windows.
uncertainty.rationale: Original tasks use different splitting units and clinical files can share people. Five random seeds are not five independent human cohorts.

paper_win_requires: Recover original full12 dataset/cohort/split membership and preprocessing, preserving within-person and person-level tasks separately.
Authenticate source CBraMod checkpoints/recipes and execute an original-task author reference; retain each published table value separately.
Freeze the complete metric panel, primary decision rule, task-specific meaningful effects, multiplicity/uncertainty and concrete matched budgets before candidate feedback.

Surpass source-paper results on that complete original support. A PhysioNet-only result, revised TUAB/TUEV partition, different pretraining exposure or person-held-out30%-label program is separately reported extension and cannot satisfy this task.

current_sota.description: Historical reported BIOT/LaBraM and other comparator scores do not establish current SOTA, especially where exact original split comparability is disclaimed.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending original full-panel source recovery. Once qualified, allow repeated method changes using only original training/development feedback and declared shared pretrained resources; log all twelve datasets and all runs without dropping failures.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate, twelve dataset manifests, original splits, source versions, preprocessing, checkpoint identities, per-dataset metrics/decision, seeds and budgets before any original test feedback.
episode.final_evaluation: Execute candidate and authenticated author reference on the complete original task panel; report published, rerun and candidate metrics separately with uncertainty. Existing person_heldout_low_label_30pct evaluation remains an extension and cannot issue this paper-win verdict.
episode.baseline_policy: Maintain original reported results, source reruns and new-split comparators as distinct. Neither an authored loader approximation nor a paper percentage on unmatched support is a valid author baseline; no convenient dataset subset replaces the full program.
